rules.name: Private key block
rules.description: A PEM or OpenPGP private key block (RSA, EC, DSA, OpenSSH, PKCS#8 or PGP) with key material.

rules.name: AWS access key ID
rules.description: An AWS access key ID (long-term AKIA or temporary ASIA credentials).

rules.name: AWS secret access key
rules.description: An AWS secret access key assigned next to an AWS key name. Reported with the access key ID it pairs with when both are in the same file.

rules.name: GitHub token
rules.description: A GitHub personal access token (ghp_), OAuth token (gho_), user-to-server token (ghu_), server-to-server token (ghs_) or refresh token (ghr_).

rules.name: GitHub fine-grained token
rules.description: A GitHub fine-grained personal access token (github_pat_).

rules.name: Stripe live secret key
rules.description: A Stripe secret key for live mode (sk_live_). Test-mode keys are not reported.

rules.name: Stripe live restricted key
rules.description: A Stripe restricted key for live mode (rk_live_).

rules.name: Slack token
rules.description: A Slack bot, user, app or configuration token (xoxb-, xoxp-, xoxa-, xoxr-, xoxs-, xapp-).

rules.name: Slack incoming webhook URL
rules.description: A Slack incoming webhook or workflow trigger URL. Anyone holding it can post to the channel.

rules.name: Google API key
rules.description: A Google Cloud or Firebase API key (AIza).

rules.name: Twilio API key
rules.description: A Twilio API key SID (SK followed by 32 hex characters).

rules.name: Twilio auth token
rules.description: A Twilio account auth token assigned next to a Twilio key name.

rules.name: SendGrid API key
rules.description: A SendGrid API key (SG. followed by two base64url parts).

rules.name: JSON Web Token
rules.description: A signed JSON Web Token whose header decodes to JSON with an alg field. Often a long-lived service credential.

rules.name: Database URL with password
rules.description: A connection string for Postgres, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, MongoDB, Redis or AMQP with a password embedded in it.

rules.name: Hard-coded credential assignment
rules.description: A quoted value, or an unquoted value in a KEY=value line, assigned to a name containing password, secret, token or api key. Scored by entropy, with placeholders, environment lookups and escaped strings skipped.

rules.name: Committed .env file
rules.description: A .env file in the tree. These hold real configuration values and belong in .gitignore; ship a .env.example instead.
